hook.en: After closing, you sneak his file back into the law-library archive. The student-body president was watching from the mezzanine.
hook.zh: 闭馆后，你偷偷把他的档案放回法学院档案箱。学生会主席一直在夹层上看着你。

options.en: Tell him the truth: someone is setting him up.
'Report me, then. I'll tell the board what's in it.'
options.zh: “那你举报我啊，我就告诉理事会里面写了什么”

caps.en: Archive closes at ten.
caps.zh: 档案室十点就关了。

caps.en: You're on my camera at twelve-fifty.
caps.zh: 十二点五十，你出现在我的监控里。

caps.en: I was just returning a book.
caps.zh: 我只是来还一本书。

caps.en: You were returning my file.
caps.zh: 你是来还我的档案。

caps.en: I could report you. Or you tell me who sent you.
caps.zh: 我可以举报你。或者，你告诉我是谁派你来的。

caps.en: You wouldn't believe me.
caps.zh: 说了你也不会信。

caps.en: You have until I put this back.
caps.zh: 在我把它放回去之前，你想清楚。

hook.en: You benched the hockey captain in the final. Now he's backed you against the locker-room door - and he can feel your pulse.
hook.zh: 决赛里你把冰球队长按上了替补席。现在他把你逼到更衣室门上——还摸到了你的心跳。

options.en: Clear him: "One drink. Then you're benched again."
options.zh: 放行他：“就一杯。喝完你继续坐冷板凳。”

options.en: Slip past him into the locker room: "Rules are rules, captain."
options.zh: 从他身边钻进更衣室：“守规矩，队长。”

caps.en: You benched me in the third period.
caps.zh: 第三节你把我按在了替补席上。

caps.en: You failed the concussion check.
caps.zh: 你脑震荡检查没过。

caps.en: Ask me anything. Name, date... your number.
caps.zh: 随便问。名字、日期……你的电话。

caps.en: Your pulse is faster than mine.
caps.zh: 你的心跳比我还快。

caps.en: Clear me, doc. One drink, just us.
caps.zh: 批准我吧，医生。就喝一杯，就我们俩。

hook.en: You're the auditor who found the family's second ledger. The heir comes down to the cellar - his father wants you gone, and he wants to know whose side you're on.
hook.zh: 你是查出家族第二本账的审计师。继承人走下酒窖——他父亲要你消失，而他想知道你站在谁那边。

options.en: Take the glass: 'For you. But the ledger stays with me.'
options.zh: 接过酒杯：“替你做事。但账本归我。”

options.en: Ask him what happened to the last auditor.
options.zh: 问他：上一个审计师怎么样了

caps.en: Most people who find that book leave through the back door.
caps.zh: 找到那本账的人，大多是从后门被抬出去的。

caps.en: You're still here.
caps.zh: 你还没走。

caps.en: I'm not leaving without it.
caps.zh: 不带上它，我不走。

caps.en: You wanted me to find you.
caps.zh: 你是想让我找到你。

caps.en: My father wants you gone by morning. I said I'd handle it.
caps.zh: 我父亲要你天亮前消失。我说，交给我处理。

caps.en: Handle me how?
caps.zh: 怎么处理我？

caps.en: So. Do you work for him, or for me?
caps.zh: 所以，你是替他做事，还是替我？

hook.en: The power dies at the top of the tower. Out of the dark doorway comes your new bodyguard - and he puts himself between you and the windows.
hook.zh: 顶层公寓突然断电。黑暗的门洞里走出你的新保镖，他一言不发，挡在你和窗户之间。

tags: close-protection officer, cold outside, warm inside

options.en: Grab his collar: "I'm not leaving without you."
options.zh: 揪住他的衣领：“没有你我不走。”

options.en: Hold his wrist: "They're not here for me, Rafe. They're here for you."
options.zh: 抓住他的手腕：“他们不是冲我来的，Rafe，是冲你。”

caps.en: Don't move. They're watching the windows.
caps.zh: 别动。他们在盯着窗户。

caps.en: Who's out there?
caps.zh: 外面是谁？

caps.en: Two on the stairs. One in the lift.
caps.zh: 楼梯上两个，电梯里一个。

caps.en: Service door. Count to thirty, then run.
caps.zh: 走员工通道。数到三十，然后跑。

caps.en: If I'm not behind you by thirty, don't come back for me.
caps.zh: 数到三十我还没跟上来，就别回来找我。

hook.en: Your ex texted at 11:42 last night. Your boyfriend of three years read every word - and now he wants to watch you answer.
hook.zh: 前任昨晚 11:42 发来消息。交往三年的男友一个字不落全看完了——现在他要看着你回。

tags: easygoing boyfriend who is quietly serious

options.en: Type it in front of him: "I'm happy. Don't text me again."
options.zh: 当着他的面打字：“我很好，别再联系我。”

options.en: "He's not texting about us, Noah. It's about my sister."
options.zh: “他发消息不是为了我们，Noah。是因为我妹妹。”

caps.en: You still have him saved as 'Home'.
caps.zh: 你还把他存成“家”。

caps.en: I didn't answer him.
caps.zh: 我没回他。

caps.en: I know. I read the whole thread.
caps.zh: 我知道。整段聊天我都看完了。

caps.en: Three years. I've never once asked for your password.
caps.zh: 三年了。我一次都没问过你的密码。

caps.en: So answer him. Right now. While I watch.
caps.zh: 那就回他。现在。当着我的面。

hook.en: The CEO who just bought your company stopped the elevator. He wants ten minutes - and you.
hook.zh: 刚收购你公司的 CEO 让电梯停了。他要十分钟——还要你。

tags: rival CEO who just acquired her firm
cold, in control, cares more than he admits

options.en: Uncap the pen: "Fine. You'll regret hiring me."
options.zh: 拔开笔帽：“行。你会后悔雇了我。”

options.en: Press the contract to his chest: "Restart the elevator, Julian."
options.zh: 把合同按回他胸口：“让电梯动起来，Julian。”

caps.en: You've taken the stairs for six weeks.
caps.zh: 你已经走了六个星期的楼梯了。

caps.en: Don't bother. I had maintenance stop it.
caps.zh: 别按了。是我让维修停的。

caps.en: You did what?
caps.zh: 你干了什么？

caps.en: Ten minutes. Head of strategy, or clear out your desk.
caps.zh: 十分钟。当战略总监，或者收拾桌子走人。

caps.en: I'd rather you hate me from the office next door.
caps.zh: 我宁可你在隔壁办公室恨我。
